title: Dye-terminator DNA sequencing
author: Diep R R Ganguly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhxmj7k6

steps.title: Gel purify and enzymatic cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the target DNA band from an agarose gel using the Wizard SV Gel and PCR Clean-Up System (Promega) according to the manufacturer’s instructions; if multiple bands are present, select the band of the expected size. Then enzymatically clean the purified DNA by hydrolyzing excess primers and nucleotides: incubate at 37 °C for 30 min followed by 80 °C for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Purify DNA with Wizard SV Gel and PCR Clean-Up System

steps.title: Set up sequencing PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing reactions in PCR tubes or a 96‑well plate using the BigDye Terminator Cycle Sequencing Kit with forward or reverse primer. Use the 5× reaction buffer (400 mM Tris, 10 mM MgCl₂) supplied with the kit.

steps.title: Run sequencing thermal cycle
steps.instruction: Thermal cycle: 1 min at 96 °C; then 30–40 cycles of 96 °C for 10 s, 50 °C for 5 s, and 60 °C for 4 min; finally hold at 4–12 °C.

steps.title: Post‑PCR ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the completed sequencing reaction to a nuclease‑free microcentrifuge tube. Add 2.5 µL of 125 mM EDTA ensuring it contacts the bottom of the tube, then add 30 µL of 100 % ethanol and mix well by inversion. Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL 100 % ethanol and invert to mix

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C at maximum speed for 30 min. Discard the supernatant, add 50 µL of ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, and centrifuge again at 4 °C at maximum speed for 5 min. Discard the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet in the dark for more than 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant; add 50 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol
Discard supernatant; air‑dry >15 min in dark

steps.title: Resuspend in HiDi Formamide
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 7.5 µL HiDi Formamide (add to empty wells if using a plate). Incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then transfer the solution to the sequencing plate and spin down briefly.

steps.title: Denature and chill
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 95 °C for 3 min to denature the sample, then place immediately on ice and spin down briefly.

steps.title: Submit for capillary sequencing
steps.instruction: Keep the samples on ice and load them onto the 3130X Genetic Analyzer (Applied Biosystems) for sequencing.
